snippet.title: Instant Sports 2 - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
This summer, gather your friends and jump into 10 sports in Instant Sports 2, available on PS5 and Nintendo Switch on July 16! Physical editions will be available in September.

Whether you're a sports fanatic or just looking for a good time, Instant Sports 2 has 10 unique events designed for maximum fun. Challenge your friends, beat your personal bests, and customize your character with hundreds of options. 🎾🏓🛹
